name: AI Chat
description: Places a floating AI chat, using ai_assistant_api on the bottom-right of pages for selected roles.
project_description: AI Chat places a floating chat bubble on the bottom-right of every page for users whose roles have been assigned an AI Assistant. The widget is backed by the AI Assistant API (part of the AI Agents project): messages are POSTed to a controller that runs the selected ai_assistant entity through ai_assistant_api.runner and returns the reply as JSON, which the vanilla-JS widget renders into chat bubbles. Administrators map one or more assistants to each user role, pick a per-role default, and set a chat title and primary colour on the settings form at /admin/config/ai/ai-chat. Conversation continuity is handled with a per-assistant thread id kept in the browser's localStorage and a per-user private tempstore on the server. The module ships no entities, plugins, permissions, Drush commands or config schema of its own; all AI behaviour, tools and agents come from the configured ai_assistant entity.
